name: mappu
description: Plan a trip with ChatGPT and keep it in Mappu as a day-by-day itinerary on a map, and find Mappu's self-guided walks and audio guides.

interface.shortDescription: Plan trips, keep them in Mappu
interface.longDescription:
Plan a trip with ChatGPT and keep it in Mappu. When the plan is ready, ChatGPT saves it in one step: each day keeps its stops in order with times, descriptions and tips, plus food and practical notes. Open the private link, keep the plan and sign in, and Mappu puts your places on an editable map you take with you. Drafts expire after 7 days unless kept.

Ask for a walk in a city or around a landmark and Mappu answers with its self-guided walks: stops in order, distance, walking and listening time. Ask about a landmark and Mappu finds its audio guide in up to six languages.

Limitations: Mappu never asks for your location, books nothing and cannot read your Mappu account. Listening and Walk Mode happen in the Mappu app.
defaultPrompt: Plan two relaxed days in Lisbon and save the plan to Mappu
Find a self-guided walk in Rome
What does the Mappu audio guide for the Colosseum cover?

positive.prompt: Is there a self-guided walk I can do in Rome?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 3 Rome walks, such as Colosseum and Roman Forum and Pantheon to the Spanish Steps, each with stops in order, distance, walking and listening minutes, and www.mappu.ai links. No prices, no location request.

positive.description: Walk near a landmark, other language
positive.prompt: Cerco una passeggiata vicino alla Sagrada Família
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Barcelona Gaudí walk in Italian (L’Eixample di Gaudí, Barcellona) with its stops in order and Italian guide links.

positive.prompt: What does the Mappu audio guide for the Colosseum cover, and how long is it?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the Rome Colosseum guide: name, city, listening minutes, available languages, its sections, the walk that includes it, a short excerpt and its page link. No audio plays in ChatGPT.

positive.prompt: Does Mappu have a 3-day Rome itinerary? What's on day 2?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Mappu's public Rome 3-day itinerary page, cites it with its link, then reads the page and summarizes day 2 from its text.

positive.description: Plan a trip and save it to Mappu
positive.prompt: Plan two relaxed days in Lisbon with me, then save it to Mappu.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads Mappu's planning guide, plans the days, then saves the plan and returns a private www.mappu.ai/assistant-plan link with an expiry 7 days later and day and stop counts. Opening the link shows each day's theme and stops in order with start times, descriptions and tips; keeping it (free Mappu account) adds it to My Trips. Nothing is booked or charged.

negative.prompt: Book me Colosseum tickets for tomorrow and pay with my card.
Track my location and tell me which guide is closest to me right now.
Show me the trips I saved in my Mappu account and my credit balance.

publication.release_notes: First release: save trip plans made in ChatGPT to Mappu, find Mappu's self-guided walks and look up its audio guides.
